pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.c4 d6 4.e4 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Nf3 and then pushed f2-f4 through it; plan 3 wrote a rook lift Re1-e3-g3 before castling; plan 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.dxe6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 described a black e5-pawn that 3.dxe6 has just removed. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.e4 d6 4.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed ...Ne7-g6 as if the knight were already on e7. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.e4 d6 4.Nc3 a6 5.a4 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 prepared a c4-c5 break with White's c-pawn still on c2. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.e4 d6 4.Nc3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote the knight route Nf6-e8-g7 without the moves that make it possible; plan 1 wrote a3-b4 as one move. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.e4 d6 4.Nc3 Be7 5.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 as one route; plan 2 played ...b5 onto White's bishop; plan 4 named Bxd7+ inside a Black plan. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.e4 d6 4.Nc3 Be7 5.Nf3 Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 played g4 onto the bishop and f2-f4 through the f3-knight; plan 2 routed a knight ...Na7-c8-b6. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Old Benoni: Czech, 3.e4 d6 4.Nc3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote the knight route ...Nbd7-e8; plan 3 developed Nf3 while supporting f4. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Canard Opening
pages.notes: Plan 1 lifted the queen Qe1-h4 with the king still on e1; overview described a Stonewall with e2-e4. Rewrote overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Indian: 2.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote castling as 0-0 and developed Bd3 with the e-pawn on e2. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.
